name: mediator complex subunit 12
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MED12 encodes mediator of RNA polymerase II transcription subunit 12. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to MED12-related intellectual disability syndrome (x-linked); FG syndrome 1 (x-linked). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Malignant phyllodes tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
